name: Portproof
description: Local stdio server for Portproof proxy traffic, sold by the GB on shared mobile 4G/5G and residential pools. Reads pricing, service status and countries online without a key; with an API key it checks the GB balance, builds proxy URLs, tests a connection, buys GB traffic and manages private mobile ports. Paid actions are refused unless called with confirm: true and an idempotency key.
author: Portproof

PORTPROOF_API_KEY.description: Portproof API key from the dashboard (https://portproof.org/app/keys). Not needed for pricing, status and countries online; required for the account tools (traffic balance, proxy URLs, connection tests, purchases and ports).
